description: Discover the dark history of the ancient Bronze Bull of Phalaris, a horrific torture device designed in ancient Greece. #history #darkhistory #shorts

scenes.text: In ancient Greece, a ruthless ruler commissioned a hollow statue made entirely of solid bronze.
Criminals and enemies were locked alive inside the iron belly of the beast.
A massive fire was lit underneath, slowly roasting the victims alive inside.
The statue was acoustically engineered so their screams sounded like an enraged bull's roar.
In a twisted turn of fate, its creator was the very first person locked inside.

title: The Real Dracula: Vlad the Impaler 🧛‍♂️ #shorts
description: The true dark history of Vlad the Impaler, the ruthless ruler who inspired the legend of Dracula. #history #darkhistory #dracula #shorts

scenes.text: Long before Bram Stoker's fiction, Vlad III ruled Wallachia with unmatched terror.
He famously invited hundreds of corrupt nobles to a feast, only to slaughter them all.
His favorite method of execution earned him the chilling nickname The Impaler.
It is said he once dined calmly in front of a forest of thousands of impaled bodies.
Even invading armies turned back in pure horror upon seeing his gruesome warning fields.

title: The Terrifying Iron Maiden Device ⛓️ #shorts
description: Inside the medieval torture device known as the Iron Maiden. The dark history of medieval punishments. #history #darkhistory #torture #shorts

scenes.text: During the medieval ages, inventors designed some of the most horrific devices in human history.
The Iron Maiden was an upright iron cabinet lined with sharp spikes inside.
When the heavy doors slowly closed, the spikes would pierce the victim without hitting vital organs.
This ensured that the agonizing torture lasted for hours in absolute darkness.
It remains one of the darkest symbols of medieval cruelty and paranoia.
